product_name: UGREEN USB C SD Card Reader Aluminum Type C Micro SD Adapter Thunderbolt 3 for SD/TF/Micro SDXC/SDHC/MMC/RS-MMC Compatible with iPhone 16/15 Galaxy S24 MacBook iPad
description: 5Gbps High-speed: UGREEN SD Card Reader supports data transfer up to 5Gbps and memory card capacity up to 2TB, 10X faster than USB 2.0 (480Mbps), which allows you to transfer an HD movie or files in seconds. Simultaneously Reading&Writing: The 2 in 1 External Memory Card Reader supports reading and writing two cards at the same time, there is no need to plug and unplug. Support UHS-I SD, SDHC, SDXC, Micro SD, Micro SDHC, Micro SDXC, MMC, and RS-MMC cards. Note: This Micro SD Card Reader supports UHS-II SD/TF cards, but the speed will be UHS-I. Plug and Play: No exact App, driver, or power is required. This card reader is widely compatible with Windows 11/10/8.1/8/7/XP/Vista, Mac OS, Linux, Android, Chrome OS, etc. Note: If you use it on a smartphone, please ensure your mobile phone supports the OTG function. Lightweight Aluminum Design: The Aluminum design card adapter has excellent heat dissipation and provides stable bidirectional transmission. It also provides over-current, over-voltage, short-circuit, and over-temperature protection. In addition, the card adaptor is designed with braided nylon cable, and it won't block your other ports, which is easy access to neighboring ports. Universal Compatibility: UGREEN Micro SD Card Adapter could be used for most Type C (Thunderbolt 4/3) OTG phones/tablets/PCs to trail cameras, car recorders, game cameras, deer cameras, private security cameras, drones, etc. It is widely compatible with iPhone 16/15/Plus/Pro/Pro Max, Galaxy S24/S23/S22/A54/A34/S10/Note 20, MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, Mac mini, iMac, iPad Pro 2024, iPad Air 5/4, Galaxy Tab S6 Lite, Pixel 9/8/7 Pro and more USB-C devices.
